name: @reddb/memory
description: reddb.io memory plugin — governed operational memory for code agents: markdown notes, RedDB graph memory, governed recall, lifecycle hooks, MCP/HTTP read surfaces, Workbench diagnostics, and Skill telemetry for self-improvement.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist-bundle/memory-cli.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: RED_MEMORY_RECALL_P50_TARGET_MS=250 vitest run tests/recall-latency.test.ts && vitest run --exclude tests/recall-latency.test.ts
